Lesson overview:
- Level: A1 General English
- Unit: MODULE 1. FIRST CONTACT & PERSONAL IDENTITY
- Time: 60 min (Essential) / 90 min (Expanded) / 120 min (Full Workshop)
- Focus: Personal Profile Project
- Materials: Vocabulary cards, audio for the listening, reading handout, COSYmanuals A1 grammar pages for grammar recycling: be, have, can, possessives.
Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.
Recycles be, have got and can from Lessons 1.1–1.9.
Recycled language from the previous lesson: profile, identity.
Answer from memory: which word belongs to the previous lesson?
Which word belongs to the previous lesson?
Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

profile — a short description of a person. Example: This is my personal profile.
identity — who a person is. Example: Name and age are part of your identity.
personal — belonging to one person. Example: These are my personal details.
information — facts about someone or something. Example: Give me your information, please.
about me — facts that describe me. Example: Here is a text about me.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Let me introduce myself.
• I am ... years old.
• I live in ...
• I can speak ...
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Grammar recycling: be, have, can, possessives.
Recycle be, have got and can: I am Marta. I have got two brothers. I can speak Spanish. Present yourself in three parts: who you are, where you live, what you can do.
